claims.claim: You must have applied to or been granted status under the EU Settlement Scheme to use this enquiry service.
claims.note: The UKVI contact pages are generic and set no condition that you have applied to or been granted EUSS status.

claims.claim: The service is available to EU, EEA and Swiss nationals and their family members.
claims.note: The contact pages do not say who can use the enquiry service; the EUSS guidance describes who can apply to the scheme, not who can make enquiries.

claims.claim: It is for people who have issues with their EUSS application or settled/pre-settled status.
claims.quote: contact details for the right UKVI team to support you
claims.note: The text describes a general tool to get help from UKVI but does not mention EUSS applications or settled/pre-settled status.

claims.claim: Issues include a certificate of application not arriving.
claims.note: The text says you receive a certificate of application by post or email but does not mention enquiring when it does not arrive.

claims.claim: Issues include needing to update personal details.
claims.note: The text does not mention updating personal details.

claims.claim: Issues include status not showing correctly.
claims.note: The text does not mention status not showing correctly.
